description: This file contains benchmarking utilities for GPU kernels, including classes for performance measurement, benchmarking, and visualization, specifically for use with PyTorch and its inductor runtime. It defines classes like Performance and BenchmarkKernel, and functions for benchmarking and plotting performance metrics.

classes.name: Performance
classes.description: Data class representing performance metrics for a kernel benchmark, including setting, latency, memory bytes, bandwidth, and compute intensity.

classes.name: BenchmarkKernel
classes.description: Base class for benchmarking GPU kernels, providing methods for cloning inputs, checking accuracy, benchmarking, and visualization.

methods.name: benchmark_kernel_in_milliseconds
methods.description: Function to benchmark a callable kernel function in milliseconds, with warmup and GPU benchmarking.
